Name: WSilenceW's Paper Airplane Obelisks And Gold Clock(CP or AT)
Author: WSilenceW
Description:
2.0更新，增加黄金钟美化。

将游戏原有的4个图腾柱/方尖碑及黄金钟，替换为更加童话风的纸飞机主题图腾柱/方尖碑和黄金钟。

mod分为CP和AT两种，CP为直接替换，AT用油漆桶替换纹理，按需要选择main flies中的文件下载。

我的小红书账号：韭菜炖大鹅

====================================================================
Version 2.0 update：adds a Golden Clock retexture.

Replaces all four obelisks and gold clock with a more fairy tale style paper airplane themed design.
Available in either CP (Content Patcher) or AT (Alternative Textures) format.
